skills.name: Golden Throne
skills.description: Sits on her golden throne and inspires those around her. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Use Rate +30% (10 sec) *Hit Rate +30% (10 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +30% (10 sec)

skills.name: Honeybee Bomb
skills.description: Attacks enemies with honeybees. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Enemy Move Speed -40% (6 sec) *ATK per sec x 1100% Area Damage (4 sec)

abilities.name: Gas Mask
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability won't take damage in advent stages  with the Poison Gas obstacle effect.

abilities.name: Skill Barrier
abilities.description: Continuously provides a barrier that protects against Skill Damage. - The Skill Barrier disappears after blocking Skill Damage 1 time and is reapplied 3 seconds later. - The Skill Barrier remains intact when Skill Damage is reduced to 0 through invincibility. - Boss, Guardian, and Special Type enemies' Skill Damage cannot be blocked.
